title: Evaluation of PICS
summary: This study is aimed to obtain the symptom burden of patients who have received intensive care treatment in the domains of physical, cognitive and mental health and to analyze it in the couse. Furthermore, impact factors of acute intensive care treatment on the development of PICS will be identified.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
intensive care treatment
Exclusion criteria:
none
